title: Making Balms
description:
Balms are a mixture of fats and waxes to create fairly

them into a container. Specific instructions are outlined
here, with recipes for different balms to follow.

steps.instruction: Melt the oils and waxes in a double boiler

spill over the edges

shrink so it should end up having a flat top
